name: Eldritch Chaos Orb
description: If The Searing Exarch is dominant, reroll prefix modifiers. If The Eater of Worlds is dominant, reroll suffix modifiers.
directions: Right click this item then left click a rare item with The Searing Exarch or The Eater of Worlds dominance to apply it.
consoleDirections: X to select, then  A on a rare item with The Searing Exarch or The Eater of Worlds dominance to apply it.
